instantiate_Gemma3_500m: instantiate the Gemma3_500m transformer model class with its default 500M parameter configuration
access_Gemma3_500m_config: access the Gemma3_500m config to inspect embed_dim, num_heads, head_dim, and attention types
run_Gemma3_500m_forward: run a forward pass through the Gemma3_500m model with token inputs to get logits
inspect_Gemma3_500m_attention_pattern: inspect the GEMMA3_ATTENTION_PATTERN used by Gemma3_500m with its local sliding and global attention layers
check_Gemma3_500m_model_info: check the Gemma3_500m INFO attribute to get the tokenizer version and model metadata
